scan_details.problematicLine: query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = '" + username + "'"
scan_details.remediationAdvise: Consider using prepared statements instead of concatenations when building SQL statement.
scan_details.description: Dynamically constructing SQL queries through string concatenation can lead to SQL injection vulnerabilities, allowing attackers to manipulate queries and execute arbitrary commands. Properly handling user input and using parameterized queries are essential to prevent unauthorized data access and protect against data breaches.

scan_details.remediationAdvise: Use the 'subprocess' module with a list of arguments to prevent OS command execution vulnerabilities.
scan_details.description: Dynamically generating OS commands without proper validation can lead to command injection attacks, allowing malicious input to be executed. This poses a risk of unauthorized access and data compromise, making safe command handling essential for security.
